independent_bending_stiffness.engineering_interpretation: Outer elastic EI exceeds inner EI, independently supporting the qualitative larger outer bending share. This does not reproduce nonlinear Figure 10 curves.

observations: Global buckling is initiated when the total effective axial force exceeds the buckling capacity.
Two horizontal imperfections are introduced at 1500 m and 3500 m.
At initiation the total effective axial force drops; after initiation it approaches a nearly constant post-buckling level.
The outer pipe goes into tension while the inner pipe continues to increase compression.
Two global buckles occur near the introduced imperfection locations.
The outer pipe is in tension along the whole model length and the inner pipe is in compression.
The total effective-force slopes show feed-in toward the buckles.

figure10.interpretation: The paragraph states approximately 300 MNm and 850 MNm, while Figure 10 uses Moment [kNm] with values on a 0-1000 scale. This is retained as an open source-internal unit mismatch.
